invalidation.rule: Basket drawdown >= 30% from its running peak (mechanical), OR two consecutive quarters in which at least two of MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN cut forward capex guidance (manual check at each scoring run).

thesis: Frontier-model demand is compute-bound; the money is paid to whoever sells the compute, power, and memory the hyperscalers must buy regardless of which model wins. Hold the sellers of the bottleneck, not the users of it.
title: AI infrastructure — sellers of the compute bottleneck (margin account)
